title: Lech Lecha Rashi 6

chapters.title: Darkness and fear falling upon Avraham
chapters.about: Hashicha gedola and the beginning of Rashi on perak tad-vav pasuk yud-bet.

chapters.title: Rashi's math on the 400 years and Mitzrayim
chapters.about: Calculating the years from the birth of Yitzhak, Yaakov's age, and the time in Mitzrayim.

chapters.title: Eretz lo lahem and the suffering of the exiles
chapters.about: Discussing the land not belonging to them yet and how Mitzrayim compressed the suffering.

chapters.title: Ve'gam et hagoi and the great wealth
chapters.about: Rashi on the other galuyot, the ten makhot, and leaving Mitzrayim with big assets.

chapters.title: Avraham coming to his fathers in peace
chapters.about: Tevoy el avotecha b'shalom, Terach, and sevah tovah.

chapters.title: The fourth generation returning and the Emorim
chapters.about: V'dor revi'i yashuvu hena and the sin of the Emorim not being complete yet.

chapters.title: The sun setting and Rashi's grammatical lesson
chapters.about: V'hi ha-shemesh ba'ah, the fiery furnace and smoke, and ta'am o le-mala for dikduk.

summary: Rabbi Soffer goes through several consecutive pesukim in Perashat Lech Lecha, focusing closely on Rashi's commentary on the covenant between the pieces. He explains Rashi's calculations regarding the 400-year prophecy of the exiles and the generations in Egypt, and also touches on Rashi's grammatical analysis of verb tenses near the end of the perasha.
questions: How does Rashi resolve the discrepancy between the 400-year exile prophecy and the 210 years Bnei Yisrael actually spent in Mitzrayim?
Why does Rashi explain that the land was not yet considered theirs during the lifetimes of Avraham, Yitzhak, and Yaakov?
How do the generations from Levi, Kehat, and Amram line up with the fourth generation returning to Eretz Yisrael?
What does Rashi explain about the fiery furnace and smoke passing between the animal parts?
How does Rashi use the cantillation marks to teach grammar and verb tenses in the pasuk about the sun setting?
